summary: Rewrote upload_file in archive/hollin.py for Hollin v3 and the upload client standard: plan chunk sizes (pro treated as team), parts numbered from 1, Part-Checksum as sha256=base64, file checksum as unpadded base64url, resume with the received-parts check, and the parts_missing and 410 replacement-session handling. Tests run against a simulated server and pass. One judgement call: the hollin-checksums page says the file checksum is hex, but the changelog (2026-09-01) says it is now unpadded base64url, so I used base64url.
